caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot centered on a plain, off-white background. The teapot is rendered predominantly in shades of grey, with shading that suggests a metallic or reflective surface. It has a broad, rounded body, a narrow neck, and a domed lid, which is topped with a small red knob. The spout of the teapot curves outward to the left, and the handle, which is ornate with a decorative scroll-like top, curves to the right. The teapot stands on a short, cylindrical pedestal base. In the bottom right corner of the image, the name “ROBERT BRIGADIER” is written in thin, uppercase letters, along with the date “12/9/36”.
title: Pewter Teapot
